affected_metric.observed_raw_baseline: 13/18 product/business chains reached canonical live in the latest complete weekly review, but verified numeric gains remained 0/21; 17 Holistic House product classes in the 2026-10-09 closure had no assigned same-source outcome metric
affected_metric.conditional_target_raw: 1/4 -> 2/4 only after one named existing denominator item enters the numerator under the unchanged formula

root_cause.statement: The management chain can select, implement, merge, deploy and independently verify user-facing product work without first binding that work to an immutable denominator event, current raw baseline source and exact same-source transition. Live capability therefore cannot enter a dashboard numerator and is repeatedly recorded as zero measured effect.
root_cause.prior_scope: Trends pilots repeatedly reached live without causal eligibility
root_cause.expanded_scope_confirmed: The same omission now affects high-throughput Holistic House product delivery

published_metric_source.limitation: Published source is stale; durable memory preserves the raw baseline without calculating a new daily metric.

owner.measurement_contract_owner: selected product implementation and release owner

smallest_safe_corrective_action: Before the next product assignment, select exactly one existing immutable denominator event that the proposed change can add, complete or reclassify.
Persist the unchanged metric formula, current raw baseline source, exact expected transition, instrumentation owner and canonical reread path before implementation begins.
Require the implementation runner and PR Delivery Sweep to fail closed when the denominator event or same-source measurement path is absent.
Return NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC instead of fabricating a metric binding; the product owner may then explicitly authorize capability-only work with zero expected metric credit.
After live verification, require Evening Delivery Closure to reread the exact same source and formula before the numerator or score can change.
Do not grant retrospective metric credit to the 17 already-live uninstrumented product classes.

expected_effect.raw_target: one named existing product-delivery denominator item enters the numerator after a future eligible release
expected_effect.measurement: preassigned baseline event plus canonical same-source reread after exact-source live verification
expected_effect.credit_policy: Assignment, instrumentation, PR, merge, deployment, route availability and documentation receive zero metric credit. Count only the observed unchanged-formula numerator transition.
